episode_summary: Megan Walters shares her journey of building a successful real estate business without buying leads or cold calling. She emphasizes the importance of personal branding, community engagement, and consistent social media presence. Megan provides actionable insights on lead generation, time management, and investment strategies, making this episode a valuable resource for agents looking to scale their business.
